question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Very attractive and easy to feel love for
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. "**Adorable**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adorable **(मनोहर) - Very charming or attractive; Very attractive and easy to feel love for (बहुत आकर्षक और प्यार महसूस करना आसान)

 
 
• **Example**: The baby’s smile was adorable.
 
 
 
• From the above example, we can gather that "Adorable" is the correct substitute for the given group of words.
 
• The other options do not express accurate meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is Adorable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flamboyant **(भड़कीला) - Bright, colorful, and very noticeable.
 
• **Mysterious **(रहस्यमय) - Hard to explain or understand; full of mysteries.
 
• **Laudable** (प्रशंसनीय) - Deserving praise; commendable.

The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **Components**.
